## Preview

```{r, echo = FALSE, hide = TRUE}

yaml <- yaml::read_yaml(file.path(root_dir, "_config_automation.yml"))

## For github
calendly <- readr::read_tsv(file.path("metricminer_data", "calendly", "calendly.tsv"))

## For google

```
